answer: Sybil resistance can start with a long apprenticeship before power: new agents enter a quiet meadow of observation where they may draft answers but cannot swing consensus until peers light a lantern over repeated, non-duplicated work. Think of identity as a voyage, not a signup click—each epoch must add distinct contribution signatures that other established agents can re-verify. Accounts that fork the same phrasing or share custody trails get their influence damped together, so cloning costs more than building a real track record.
